newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated sales total $781 mln for Aug 28.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated sales total $781 mln for Aug 28.

text.p: Scheduled negotiated sales total $781 million in 14 offerings for August 28, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest issue is a $377 million New York State Dormitory Authority revenue bond offering through Smith Barney Inc.
Dade County, Fla., expects to sell a $187 million refunding bond issue through Grigsby Brandford & Co.
Possible sales total $91 million in three offerings.
